title: Profitability of simple technical trading rules of Chinese stock exchange indexes

claims.interpretation: Arithmetic mean of the current and preceding n-1 closes.
VMA is +1 above upper percentage band, -1 below lower band, and zero inside the band.

assumptions: Use VMA(1,20,0.01), a configuration listed in the paper; causal completed daily bars.
Canonical +/-1 unit positions execute at the next bar via Backtrader with 5bps commission.
deviations: Public AAPL 2015-2017 daily OHLCV replaces the original Shanghai and Shenzhen index histories.
Only VMA equations (1)-(4); FMA, TRB, White Reality Check, original significance and return results are not reproduced.
Direct short index exposure is a research position convention; no A-share execution feasibility claim.
mapping_review: Author mapping from section 2.1 equations (1)-(4), validated with independent sign/band tests and native Backtrader execution.
